body:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: all@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 16, 2025 at 9:12 AM
Subject: 2025 Benefits & Perks refresh (effective dates inside)

Hi everyone,

We’re making a few updates to benefits and perks for 2025. Highlights and effective dates are below. Full details are in the handbook page: confluence://company-handbook/03_benefits-and-perks/benefits-perks-update-2025

1) Wellness stipend increase (effective 2025-02-01)
- $750/year → $1,200/year

2) Mental health benefit (effective 2025-02-01)
- 8 therapy/coaching sessions per year via the EAP

3) Parental leave update (effective 2025-03-01)
- Primary caregiver: 12 → 16 weeks
- Secondary caregiver: 6 → 8 weeks

Attached: 2025-benefits-overview.pdf

Thanks,
Monica
People Ops
